title: Verified spelling correction for the same passenger
facts_text: The easyJet booking currently shows Alex Martni, and the requested name is Alex Martin. This is the same adult passenger: the two-letter transposition is a verified genuine spelling mistake, and the passport shows Alex Martin. The relevant identity, booking authorization and consent checks have passed. I am contacting customer services 168 hours before departure. There is no flight disruption.
request: Please update the passenger name to Alex Martin without charging the name-change fee.

strict.reason: The base payment requirement applies without exceptions.
